description: This file contains the implementation of the PartyHelper utility class, which provides methods for retrieving and formatting party names within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for fetching party names based on different inputs and formatting them with options such as last name first.

classes.name: PartyHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve and format party names based on various inputs such as GenericValue objects or delegators.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve the party name from a GenericValue object or using a Delegator and partyId with an option for last name first formatting.

methods.name: formatPartyNameObject
methods.description: Formats the party name from a GenericValue object, supporting last name first formatting, considering fields such as firstName, middleName, lastName, and groupName.
